news.headline:
Indian Bank Q1 FY26 saw 13.6% YoY business growth to ₹15.28L Cr, driven by 13.3% deposit rise & 13.9% advances growth.

Net profit rose 5% YoY to ₹3,103 Cr; GNPA fell to 1.98%, but shares dropped 18% in 2026 after hitting ₹1,000 high.

Source: Livemint

Indian Bank's Q1 FY27 total business rose 13.6% YOY to ₹15.28 Lakh Cr.

Advances grew 13.9% to ₹6.85 Lakh Cr; deposits increased 13.3%, CASA steady at 39.64%.

Source: Livesquawk
